mapper.update: UPDATE accounts SET password = #{password}, password_init = 0, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version_no = #{versionNo} + 1 WHERE username = #{username} AND version_no = #{versionNo}
UPDATE accounts SET failed_count = 0, lockout = '0', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE username = #{username}
UPDATE accounts SET failed_count = failed_count + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE username = #{username}
UPDATE accounts SET lockout = '1', locked_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, failed_count = 0, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE username = #{username}
